notes.title: Attention!
notes.content:
An important announcement that you should know about. I, the developer of this game, was taken into the army until November 2021. Based on this, you have already realized that at this time I will not be able to continue development, and of course I will continue development with tripled strength when I return. 

Please, I have a huge request for you! Don't kill this project with negative reviews and refunds. I will also duplicate this message in the game update section on the Steam page. So that each of you can read this before making a purchase.

I prepared a global update for the game, fixing a lot of bugs, a large game map, and made a lot of game mechanics + did a lot of work on optimization, including switching the game engine to a new type of render. But I didn't have time to finish just a few important points. So if you have purchased the game, read this, and have the humanity to understand me, I would be very grateful if you would wait for me and I will publish for all of you what I have been working on.
